Per the allowed_revision_policy for case Q028, the only permitted revision is adjusting the decision_threshold to 0.4.
No other changes to dataset, model, or metrics are allowed.
This result is strictly limited to the fixed UCI WDBC dataset and does not imply clinical efficacy or generalizability.
